intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

selected_hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island Boutique Stay
selected_hotel.location: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat chartered exclusively for two, sailing through the turquoise lagoon as the sun dips below the horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and a private butler service while dolphins often swim alongside the boat. This quintessential romantic experience captures the magic of the Maldives in an intimate, unhurried setting perfect for honeymooners.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Snorkeling the Manta Ray Biosphere Reserve
experiences.description: Dive into the crystal-clear waters of the UNESCO-recognized Baa Atoll Biosphere Reserve, home to one of the world's most spectacular gatherings of manta rays and whale sharks. A guided snorkeling excursion takes you through vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. The experience is both thrilling and deeply serene, offering unforgettable underwater memories for snorkeling enthusiasts.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment in an Overwater Bungalow
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature couples' spa ritual at a luxury overwater spa where the treatment room features a glass floor revealing the vibrant reef below. Choose from traditional Maldivian coconut oil massages, flower baths, and aromatherapy rituals designed for two. The combination of soothing treatments, ocean sounds, and the visual spectacle of marine life beneath you creates an unparalleled luxury and romance experience tailored for honeymooners.
experiences.location: South Malé Atoll, Olhuveli or Anantara Dhigu Resort

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank rising just inches above the Indian Ocean, where a private table is set for two with fine linens, candles, and a gourmet seafood feast prepared by a resort chef. Feast on freshly grilled lobster, Maldivian tuna curry, and tropical desserts while surrounded by nothing but endless blue water and sky. This exclusive dining experience is the ultimate romantic gesture for couples celebrating a honeymoon.
experiences.location: Ari Atoll, near Mirihi or Lily Beach Resort sandbanks

experiences.name: Night Snorkeling with Bioluminescent Plankton
experiences.description: After dark, slip into the warm lagoon waters to witness one of nature's most magical phenomena — bioluminescent plankton that glow electric blue with every movement. Guided by an expert marine biologist, you and your partner will snorkel through a living light show that illuminates the water around you like a galaxy of stars. This rare, awe-inspiring experience is deeply romantic and unlike anything else available in the world, making it a must-do for honeymooners.
experiences.location: Raa Atoll, Vaadhoo Island (Sea of Stars)

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island Boutique Stay
hotel.location: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Night Snorkeling with Bioluminescent Plankton
experiences.description: After dark, slip into the warm lagoon waters to witness one of nature's most magical phenomena — bioluminescent plankton that glow electric blue with every movement. Guided by an expert marine biologist, you and your partner will snorkel through a living light show that illuminates the water around you like a galaxy of stars. This rare, awe-inspiring experience is deeply romantic and unlike anything else available in the world, making it a must-do for honeymooners.
experiences.location: Raa Atoll, Vaadhoo Island (Sea of Stars)

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport (Malé) at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage. Arrange a budget speedboat or public ferry transfer to North Malé Atoll near Veligandu/Baros area. Check in to your boutique guesthouse, freshen up, and take a leisurely walk along the beach to get oriented. Enjoy the stunning turquoise lagoon views from the shore.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach or a nearby jetty. Explore the local area around the guesthouse and settle in for a relaxing first night.

meals.breakfast: Eaten before/during flight
meals.lunch: Grab a quick and affordable local snack or short-eat from a café near the ferry terminal in Malé (tuna-filled bajiya or samosa, ~$3–5)
meals.dinner: Dinner at your guesthouse restaurant or a nearby local eatery — try mas riha (Maldivian tuna curry) with roshi bread (~$8–12)

day_by_day.notes: Book your speedboat or ferry transfer in advance to save costs. Public ferries are the cheapest option (~$2–5) but run on limited schedules. Speedboat transfers cost ~$30–60 per person. Keep your first evening light as jet lag and travel fatigue may set in.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise beach walk. After breakfast, head to the house reef directly accessible from your guesthouse for your first snorkeling session. Explore the colorful coral gardens, spot reef fish, parrotfish, and perhaps a sea turtle. Rent snorkel gear from the guesthouse if needed (~$5–8/day).
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling trip organized by your guesthouse or a local dive center to a nearby snorkeling hotspot in North Malé Atoll. These group trips typically visit 2–3 snorkel spots and cost ~$20–30 per person. Look out for blacktip reef sharks in the shallows.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the guesthouse, rinse off, and relax on the beach. Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner as the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — local style with tuna paste, flatbread, and tea (~$5–7 or included)
meals.lunch: Pack a simple lunch from the guesthouse or buy fresh fruit and snacks from a local shop (~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Beachside dinner at the guesthouse or a local restaurant — grilled fish with rice and salad (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem. The house reef is free to use and is often just as spectacular as paid snorkel sites. Mornings offer the calmest waters and best visibility.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin-watching cruise — a budget highlight of the Maldives. Many local guesthouses offer shared sunrise dolphin cruises for ~$25–35 per person. Spinner dolphins are frequently spotted in North Malé Atoll waters at dawn.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby local island by public ferry or arranged day trip. Explore the island village, visit the local market, and interact with Maldivian locals. Browse handmade souvenirs and fresh tropical fruits. This gives an authentic cultural experience at minimal cost.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your guesthouse. Enjoy a quiet romantic evening on the beach — lay out a sarong, stargaze, and listen to the ocean waves.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the early cruise — local tea and biscuits at the guesthouse (~$3–5)
meals.lunch: Lunch at a local island café or 'hotaa' (local teahouse) — short eats and fresh juice (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Cook-your-catch dinner if available at guesthouse, or choose a set menu local dinner (~$10–14)

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed but are very common in this atoll. Dress modestly when visiting local islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for the local Muslim culture.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling at the house reef focusing on the deeper coral drop-off if accessible. Bring an underwater camera or rent a waterproof case for your phone. Try to spot moray eels, lionfish, and colorful nudibranchs hiding in crevices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Sandbank picnic excursion — one of the most romantic and budget-friendly Maldives experiences. Many guesthouses arrange shared sandbank trips for ~$20–30 per person. Spend 2–3 hours on a pristine white sandbank surrounded by nothing but turquoise water.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset kayaking from the guesthouse beach. Many budget guesthouses offer free or low-cost kayak rentals. Paddle out to watch the sunset over the lagoon with your partner for a truly romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Full guesthouse breakfast — eggs, toast, fresh fruit, and tea (~$6–8 or included)
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch on the sandbank — arrange with guesthouse the night before (simple sandwiches, fruit, water, ~$8–10)
meals.dinner: Romantic candlelit dinner at the guesthouse beach restaurant — fresh seafood platter (~$15–20)

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank trip is a must-do for honeymoon/romance travelers. Book it the day before to secure spots. Bring plenty of water, sunscreen, and a hat as there is zero shade on a sandbank.

day_by_day.morning: Guided snorkeling at a nearby coral reef known for manta ray or whale shark sightings (seasonal — March is a good time). Book through your guesthouse for a shared group trip (~$35–50 per person including guide and equipment). This is a bucket-list experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery back at the guesthouse. Enjoy the pool or beach, read a book in a hammock, and recharge. This is your slow luxury afternoon — embrace the Maldivian pace of life.
day_by_day.evening: Night snorkeling with bioluminescent plankton experience. Slip into the warm lagoon after dark and witness the magical blue glow of bioluminescent plankton with every movement. This is one of nature's most surreal phenomena and is available as a guided experience (~$30–40 per person).

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — fresh papaya, coconut pancakes, and coffee (~$6–8 or included)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the guesthouse — tuna salad sandwich and fresh coconut water (~$7–10)
meals.dinner: Early dinner before the night snorkeling session — local Maldivian curry with rice (~$9–13)

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent plankton experience is weather and tide dependent — the best conditions are on calm, dark (new moon) nights. Confirm availability with your guesthouse. Do NOT use sunscreen before night snorkeling as it harms the plankton.

day_by_day.morning: Beginner scuba diving discovery session or snuba experience if you've never dived before (~$60–80 for a resort dive). North Malé Atoll has spectacular dive sites including Banana Reef and HP Reef. If budget is tight, stick to snorkeling the same sites from the surface.
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach volleyball, paddleboarding, or simply lounging on the beach. Take an afternoon nap in a beach hammock — this is your honeymoon, after all. Walk hand-in-hand along the water's edge as the tide recedes.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private beach dinner setup with your guesthouse if budget allows (~$30–50 extra for setup with candles and flowers). Alternatively, dine at the beach restaurant under the stars for a romantic evening.

meals.breakfast: Coconut porridge or ful medames with flatbread at the guesthouse (~$5–7 or included)
meals.lunch: Beachside light meal — grilled corn, fresh fruit plate, and iced tea (~$6–9)
meals.dinner: Romantic beach or restaurant dinner — lobster or barracuda if budget allows, or grilled snapper (~$15–25)

day_by_day.notes: If you plan to scuba dive, avoid flying for 24 hours after your last dive. Discovery dives don't require certification. Many budget guesthouses can negotiate package deals for multiple activities — always ask.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session on the beach or jetty — many guesthouses offer complimentary or low-cost yoga classes (~$5–10). Start the week with mindful movement and the sound of the ocean as your backdrop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Full-day island hopping excursion visiting 3–4 nearby islands including a local inhabited island, an uninhabited island, and a snorkeling spot. Group tours run ~$40–60 per person and are excellent value. A great way to see more of the atoll.
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening back at the guesthouse. Enjoy a fresh coconut on the beach, watch the sunset, and share stories from the day's adventures.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-yoga breakfast — banana, granola, and green tea (~$4–6 or included)
meals.lunch: Lunch included in island hopping tour or eat at a local island teahouse (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner — Maldivian garudhiya fish soup with rice and lime (~$8–12)

day_by_day.notes: Island hopping tours are one of the best value experiences in the Maldives for budget travelers. You get multiple experiences in one day. Bring cash for any shopping on local islands as card payments are rare.

day_by_day.morning: Free morning to explore the immediate area around your guesthouse at your own pace. Go for a long swim, practice snorkeling techniques, or simply sit on the beach with a good book and a fresh coconut.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the capital Malé by public ferry (~$1–2 each way) for a cultural afternoon. Explore the colorful Friday Mosque (Hukuru Miskiy), the Maldives National Museum, the fish market, and the vibrant local markets. A fascinating contrast to island life.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the guesthouse by ferry before dark. Enjoy a quiet evening and start planning your remaining days. Treat yourselves to a special dessert — Maldivian bondibaiy (sweet rice pudding).

meals.breakfast: Full guesthouse breakfast (~$6–8 or included)
meals.lunch: Authentic local lunch in Malé at a teahouse — mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi, ~$4–6
meals.dinner: Guesthouse dinner or local restaurant — fish curry with steamed rice (~$9–13)

day_by_day.notes: Malé is a fascinating, densely packed city unlike any other capital. The fish market near the harbor is especially lively in the early afternoon. Keep valuables secure and dress modestly in the city.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing trip — traditional Maldivian handline fishing from a local dhoni boat. Many guesthouses offer shared sunrise fishing trips for ~$20–30 per person. A wonderful cultural experience and you may catch your own breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling at a new reef site arranged through your guesthouse — focus on finding sea turtles, which are common in North Malé Atoll. Spend the rest of the afternoon relaxing and drying off on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Bodu Beru traditional drumming and dance performance if available at a nearby resort or local community event. This traditional Maldivian music is energetic and captivating (~$10–15 or sometimes free at local events).

meals.breakfast: Post-fishing breakfast — if you caught fish, ask the guesthouse to cook it! Otherwise, standard guesthouse breakfast (~$6–8)
meals.lunch: Fresh grilled fish with salad at the guesthouse (~$8–12)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the guesthouse — mixed seafood with coconut rice (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Traditional handline fishing is sustainable and a genuine cultural activity. Always ask permission before photographing local people. Bodu Beru performances may need to be booked in advance through your guesthouse.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated underwater photography morning — head to the house reef with your camera/phone in a waterproof case. Spend 2 hours slowly observing and photographing marine life. Practice patience and stillness for the best shots.
day_by_day.afternoon: Couples spa treatment or massage at the guesthouse or a nearby budget spa. Many local guesthouses offer traditional Maldivian coconut oil massages for ~$30–50 per person — a romantic mid-trip treat without resort prices.
day_by_day.evening: Private beach time — arrange a bottle of sparkling juice or wine, lay out a blanket, and watch the stars emerge. The Maldives has virtually zero light pollution on smaller islands, making stargazing extraordinary.

meals.breakfast: Tropical fruit platter with yogurt and honey (~$6–8 or included)
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch — tuna wrap and fresh juice (~$7–10)
meals.dinner: Special mid-trip celebration dinner — order the freshest catch of the day with a side of coconut curry (~$14–20)

day_by_day.notes: The spa afternoon is a worthwhile splurge for a honeymoon/romance trip — negotiate a couples package for better value. Stargazing is best after 9 PM when boat traffic dies down. Download a star map app before your trip.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling adventure — join a shared group trip to one of North Malé Atoll's famous snorkel sites such as Manta Point or a coral garden known for large marine life. This is your last chance for a big snorkel experience (~$25–40 per person).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the guesthouse and begin light souvenir shopping. Look for locally made lacquerware, woven mats, and small coral-free jewelry pieces. Support local artisans rather than resort gift shops for better prices and authenticity.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni cruise — a traditional wooden boat sunset cruise is one of the most romantic ways to spend an evening in the Maldives (~$25–35 per person for shared cruise). Watch the sky turn pink and orange over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast — scrambled eggs with tuna, toast, and coffee (~$6–8 or included)
meals.lunch: Post-snorkel lunch at the guesthouse — rice, fish, and salad (~$8–12)
meals.dinner: Dinner at a slightly upgraded local restaurant — treat yourselves to a nicer meal as the trip winds down (~$15–22)

day_by_day.notes: Book the sunset dhoni cruise early in the morning as spots fill up. This is a perfect romantic activity for a honeymoon couple. Bring a light layer as it can get breezy on the water after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise swim and snorkel at the house reef. Take your time saying goodbye to the fish, corals, and turtles you've come to recognize over the past two weeks. A bittersweet but beautiful morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relaxed afternoon — pack, organize photos and memories, and enjoy one last long beach session. Write postcards, journal about your trip, or simply sit in silence and absorb the beauty around you.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at your favorite restaurant from the trip. Splurge slightly on this last night — order a special dish, share dessert, and toast to your honeymoon adventure in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Full guesthouse breakfast — your last Maldivian morning meal, savor it! (~$6–8 or included)
meals.lunch: Light lunch — fresh coconut, fruit, and a sandwich (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner — grilled lobster or premium seafood if budget allows, with a mocktail or local drink (~$20–30)

day_by_day.notes: Settle any outstanding bills with the guesthouse today. Confirm your departure transfer for tomorrow. Back up all your photos to cloud storage. Leave a positive review for your guesthouse — it means a lot to small local businesses.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — wake up for one last sunrise on the beach. Take a short walk, collect a small piece of sand (in a sealed vial) as a memento, and enjoy a leisurely final breakfast. Check out of the guesthouse and arrange transfer back to Velana International Airport in Malé.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at the airport with plenty of time. Browse the duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian vanilla, local crafts, or chocolates. Reflect on 13 incredible days in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives with a heart full of memories, a camera full of photos, and a renewed sense of romance and wonder. Until next time, Maldives!

meals.breakfast: Final guesthouse breakfast — enjoy every bite (~$6–8 or included)
meals.lunch: Airport café or terminal restaurant — simple meal before departure (~$10–15)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at your layover destination

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the ferry/speedboat transfer to Malé plus airport check-in. Confirm transfer time with your guesthouse the night before. Carry snorkeling gear as hand luggage if possible to avoid checked baggage fees on the way home.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Velana International Airport at 13:00 — skip morning activities. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet your resort transfer representative at the arrivals hall.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board your speedboat transfer to your boutique resort in North Malé Atoll (approx. 30–45 min ride). Arrive, check in, and settle into your overwater or beach bungalow. Enjoy a welcome drink and explore the resort grounds at a leisurely pace. Take a refreshing dip in the lagoon right off your villa.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni chartered exclusively for two, sailing through the golden-hued Indian Ocean as the sun dips below the horizon. Toast to your honeymoon with chilled champagne.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in-flight or at airport
meals.lunch: Light snack or sandwich at Velana International Airport before transfer
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at the resort's main restaurant — opt for the set romantic dinner package on the beach or overwater deck; expect fresh grilled seafood, tropical salads, and Maldivian curries (mid-range set menu ~$60–80 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat transfer timing with resort in advance. Keep travel documents handy for immigration. The sunset cruise is best booked ahead — confirm exact departure time with resort concierge upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early and enjoy a sunrise stroll along the beach or your villa's private deck. After breakfast, head to the resort's house reef for your first snorkeling session — explore colorful coral gardens, reef fish, sea turtles, and rays just steps from shore. Rent snorkel gear from the dive center if not included.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a guided snorkeling excursion to a nearby reef or coral pinnacle in North Malé Atoll — your resort's water sports team can arrange a short boat trip to a more pristine reef patch. Look for blacktip reef sharks, moray eels, and vibrant parrotfish. Return by early afternoon and relax with a tropical mocktail by the pool.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll to the resort's overwater bar for sundowners. Dine at the resort's à la carte restaurant featuring Maldivian and Asian fusion cuisine — try the tuna curry (mas riha) and coconut-based dishes for an authentic local experience.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs to order, pastries, and freshly squeezed juices (typically included in stay)
meals.lunch: Light beach shack lunch at the resort — grilled fish sandwich, fresh salad, and coconut water (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: À la carte dinner at resort restaurant — Maldivian tuna curry, grilled lobster, and mango sorbet (~$50–70 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — many resorts in the Maldives enforce this policy. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro for reef snorkeling. Check tide times with the dive center for optimal snorkeling conditions.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga session on the beach or your villa deck at sunrise (many boutique resorts offer complimentary or low-cost yoga at dawn). Follow with a hearty breakfast. Then take a guided dolphin-watching boat excursion — spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in the channels of North Malé Atoll in the mornings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the excursion and spend the afternoon at leisure. Explore the resort's water sports menu — try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or kayaking around the lagoon. Alternatively, book a couples' massage at the spa for a relaxing midday treat.
day_by_day.evening: Night Snorkeling with Bioluminescent Plankton — after dark, slip into the warm lagoon waters to witness one of nature's most magical phenomena. The glowing blue plankton illuminate the water with every movement, creating an otherworldly, deeply romantic experience unique to the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — smoothie bowls, freshly baked bread, tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the beach grill — grilled snapper, coleslaw, and fries (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual dining at the resort's poolside bistro — wood-fired pizza, pasta, and a shared dessert platter (~$40–55 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent plankton activity varies with lunar cycles — new moon periods offer the most vivid displays. Confirm with the resort's dive team whether conditions are favorable on this date. No flash photography during the night snorkel.

day_by_day.morning: After breakfast, embark on a half-day excursion to Malé city — a short speedboat ride away. Explore the colorful Malé Fish Market (best in the morning), visit the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) built in 1656, and browse local handicraft shops for souvenirs like lacquerware and woven mats.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Spend time relaxing on your private villa terrace or on the beach. Take a leisurely snorkel along the house reef and look for octopus and nudibranch in the shallower sandy areas.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa dining experience — arrange with the resort to have dinner set up on your private deck or in your bungalow. Candlelit table, fresh seafood platter, and a bottle of wine under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort before departing for Malé
meals.lunch: Authentic local lunch at a Malé café — short eats (hedhikaa) like bajiya (fish pastry), gulha, and sweet black tea (~$5–10 per person for a genuine local experience)
meals.dinner: Private in-villa romantic dinner arranged through the resort concierge — fresh lobster thermidor, tropical salad, and chocolate lava cake (~$80–100 per couple including wine)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting Malé — cover shoulders and knees, especially at the mosque. The fish market is most lively between 6–9am but still active mid-morning. Book the in-villa dinner at least 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment in an Overwater Bungalow — indulge in a signature couples' spa ritual where the treatment room features a glass floor panel revealing the vivid marine life beneath. Enjoy hot stone massage, aromatherapy, and a soothing body wrap as fish glide below you.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-spa, enjoy a light lunch and spend the afternoon snorkeling the house reef again — this time focusing on the deeper drop-off edge where larger pelagic fish, eagle rays, and reef sharks patrol. Ask the dive center to point out the best entry point for the drop-off.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's overwater bar for sunset cocktails. Join a cultural evening at the resort if offered — traditional Bodu Beru drumming and dance performances by local staff are a wonderful window into Maldivian culture.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the spa — fresh fruit, yogurt, and herbal tea
meals.lunch: Healthy spa-style lunch at the resort wellness café — grain bowls, fresh juices, and raw desserts (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Resort main restaurant — choose the seafood buffet night if available, featuring a spread of fresh catches, Maldivian curries, and international options (~$50–65 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa treatment well in advance — overwater spa slots fill up quickly, especially for couples. Arrive 15 minutes early to enjoy the relaxation lounge and complimentary herbal teas. Avoid heavy meals before the treatment.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to Baa Atoll for the Snorkeling the Manta Ray Biosphere Reserve experience — depart early by speedboat or domestic flight transfer (coordinate with resort). Dive into the crystal-clear waters of the UNESCO-recognized Baa Atoll Biosphere Reserve, home to one of the world's largest aggregations of manta rays and whale sharks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Baa Atoll's reefs with your guide — snorkel over coral gardens teeming with life. Many tours include a stop at a local island for a brief cultural visit. Begin return journey to North Malé Atoll by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive back at the resort tired but exhilarated. Enjoy a quiet, relaxing evening — a soak in your villa's outdoor bathtub or a dip in the lagoon at dusk. Low-key dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before departure — grab-and-go option if needed
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or lunch provided on the tour boat — typically includes sandwiches, fruit, and water
meals.dinner: Casual resort dinner — wood-fired flatbreads, mezze platters, and fresh fish of the day at the beach grill (~$40–55 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray aggregations at Baa Atoll are most reliable between May–November (Hanifaru Bay peak season), but rays are present year-round in smaller numbers. In March, sightings are possible but not guaranteed — confirm with local guides. This is a full-day trip; wear reef-safe SPF and stay hydrated. Baa Atoll requires a domestic flight or long speedboat ride — factor in ~$100–150 per person for transfers.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day after the Baa Atoll excursion. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and spend the morning reading, sunbathing, or floating in the lagoon. Treat yourselves to a light poolside morning with tropical smoothies.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank rising just inches above the Indian Ocean. Enjoy a beautifully arranged private picnic with chilled wine, gourmet finger foods, fresh tropical fruits, and the extraordinary sensation of being completely alone in the middle of the ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed. Sunset walk along the beach hand-in-hand. Book a table at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant for a special mid-trip celebratory dinner.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely buffet breakfast — eggs benedict, smoked fish, tropical fruits, and fresh juices
meals.lunch: The sandbank picnic IS lunch — gourmet spread of charcuterie, fresh seafood, tropical fruits, sparkling wine, and petit fours arranged by the resort (~$80–120 per couple, often bookable as a package)
meals.dinner: Signature restaurant dinner — tasting menu or à la carte with fresh Maldivian lobster, seared tuna, and a chocolate fondant dessert (~$70–90 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank excursion is weather-dependent — have a backup plan ready. Book at least 2–3 days in advance through the resort concierge. Bring sunscreen, hats, and sunglasses as there is zero shade on the sandbank. Timing is best around low tide when the sandbank is most visible.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session at a different reef site — ask the dive center to take you to a coral garden or pinnacle you haven't visited yet. Focus on macro life: nudibranchs, pipefish, and clownfish in anemones. Alternatively, try a beginner scuba diving discovery session if curious about going deeper.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the resort's amenities — use the gym, play a round of water volleyball, or simply lounge by the infinity pool with a good book. Arrange for a couples' foot massage or reflexology session at the spa.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a stargazing session on the beach if offered by the resort (many Maldivian resorts organize this with a telescope). The Maldives' remote location and minimal light pollution make for spectacular night skies. Enjoy a nightcap under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort
meals.lunch: Resort beach café — fresh tuna poke bowl, coconut prawn skewers, and a fruit smoothie (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual overwater restaurant dinner — grilled catch of the day, steamed rice, stir-fried vegetables, and a shared coconut panna cotta (~$45–60 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Discovery scuba dives must be booked through the resort's PADI dive center. No prior experience needed — an instructor accompanies you at all times. Cost is typically $80–120 per person. Stargazing sessions may require advance booking.

day_by_day.morning: Join a local island excursion to a nearby inhabited Maldivian island — experience authentic local life, visit the community school, local mosque, and small shops selling handmade crafts. A wonderful contrast to the resort bubble and a chance to connect with Maldivian culture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a relaxed afternoon. Try windsurfing or kitesurfing lessons at the water sports center (beginner-friendly options available). Alternatively, rent a catamaran for a self-guided afternoon sail around the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic overwater dinner — if your resort has an overwater restaurant or can arrange a special table on the jetty, this is the night for it. Soft lighting, the sound of the ocean beneath you, and a curated seafood menu.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast before the island excursion
meals.lunch: Lunch on the local island — visit a local 'tea house' for authentic Maldivian short eats and mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread (~$8–12 per person)
meals.dinner: Overwater or jetty dinner at the resort — fresh reef fish, prawn linguine, and a tropical fruit tart (~$55–75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for the local island visit — carry a sarong or light cover-up. Bikinis and swimwear are not permitted on inhabited islands. Bring small cash in Maldivian Rufiyaa or USD for local purchases. Windsurfing lessons typically cost $40–60 per hour.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated snorkeling morning — join the resort's guided reef snorkeling tour to their best house reef spots, including the coral bommies and turtle cleaning stations. Spend a full 2 hours in the water with a naturalist guide who identifies marine species.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spa afternoon — book individual treatments or a couples' package. Options might include a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage, a sea salt body scrub, or a rejuvenating facial. Spend the remainder of the afternoon in the spa relaxation area.
day_by_day.evening: Sundowner cocktails on the beach. Enjoy a themed dinner night at the resort if available (many resorts host weekly BBQ nights, seafood nights, or Maldivian cultural dinners). These are usually excellent value and a highlight of the stay.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast — focus on protein and energy before the snorkeling session
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the spa café or poolside — avocado toast, fresh fruit platter, and coconut water (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Resort BBQ or themed dinner night — grilled whole fish, lobster, satay skewers, and tropical desserts (~$55–70 per person, often a set buffet price)

day_by_day.notes: Ask the naturalist guide specifically about turtle cleaning stations and the best time to observe them — early morning is typically when turtles are most active. Book spa treatments at least 24 hours ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Slow morning — sleep in and enjoy a private breakfast served on your villa deck (many resorts offer in-room breakfast for an additional fee, or it may be included). Watch the sunrise from your terrace with coffee and fresh pastries. A perfect honeymoon morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final water adventure — go on a big game fishing excursion (catch and release) in the deep waters surrounding the atoll. Alternatively, take a glass-bottom boat tour for those who prefer to stay dry but still want to observe reef life. Return by mid-afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise or a romantic beach bonfire arranged by the resort. Many boutique resorts can set up a private fire pit on the beach with cushions, lanterns, and a bottle of wine — a perfect penultimate evening.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast on your private deck — fresh fruit, pastries, eggs, and coffee (~$20–30 additional if not included)
meals.lunch: Lunch on the fishing boat — packed sandwiches and snacks provided by the tour, or a casual resort lunch on return (~$20–25 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual but special dinner at the resort — if you caught a fish, some resorts will cook your catch for you! Otherwise, order the chef's special of the day with a bottle of local sparkling wine (~$50–70 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Fishing excursions typically cost $80–120 per person for a half-day. Check with the resort whether they will prepare your catch — this is a memorable experience. Beach bonfire arrangements should be made 24–48 hours in advance through the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session at your favorite house reef spot — take it slow, soak in the beauty one last time, and say goodbye to the underwater world. Bring your underwater camera for final photos. Return by mid-morning for a long, luxurious breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Packing and resort check-out preparation. Take a final stroll around the island, collect any last souvenirs from the resort boutique (Maldivian lacquerware, sarongs, locally made jewelry). Enjoy a final dip in the infinity pool or lagoon. Visit the resort's dive center to share your favorite underwater moments and get recommendations for future dives.
day_by_day.evening: Final romantic dinner at the resort — go all out for your last night. Request a special setup: a private table on the beach, candles, rose petals, and a curated 3-course menu. Share your favorite memories of the trip over a bottle of wine.

meals.breakfast: Extended leisurely breakfast — order everything you loved over the past two weeks as a final treat
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the beach grill — keep it simple with a fresh salad and grilled fish (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner — private beach setup with 3-course menu: tuna tartare starter, grilled lobster main, and a special honeymoon dessert with personalized message (~$90–120 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Request the farewell dinner setup at least 48 hours in advance — the resort team will go above and beyond for honeymooners. Ask the resort to prepare a late checkout or day-use room if your flight departs in the evening. Settle any outstanding bills the night before to avoid a rushed morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on your villa deck — wake up early one last time to watch the Indian Ocean light up in gold and pink. Enjoy a final cup of coffee by the water. Check out of the resort and board your speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at the airport with time to spare. Browse the duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian honey, vanilla, and locally crafted items make wonderful souvenirs. Relax in the airport lounge if available, or enjoy a final meal at the airport restaurant before your departure flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Velana International Airport — carry the memories of 13 magical days in the Maldives as you fly home, already dreaming of your return.

meals.breakfast: Light final breakfast at the resort or a grab-and-go option before departure
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or lounge — international options available at Velana International Airport (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. Confirm transfer timing with the resort the night before. Keep reef-safe sunscreen, snorkel gear rental receipts, and any resort package documents together for easy reference. Don't forget to leave a review for the resort — your feedback helps future honeymooners find their perfect Maldives escape!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island Boutique Stay
hotel.location: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat chartered exclusively for two, sailing through the turquoise lagoon as the sun dips below the horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and a private butler service while dolphins often swim alongside the boat. This quintessential romantic experience captures the magic of the Maldives in an intimate, unhurried setting perfect for honeymooners.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, near Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Snorkeling the Manta Ray Biosphere Reserve
experiences.description: Dive into the crystal-clear waters of the UNESCO-recognized Baa Atoll Biosphere Reserve, home to one of the world's most spectacular gatherings of manta rays and whale sharks. A guided snorkeling excursion takes you through vibrant coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. The experience is both thrilling and deeply serene, offering unforgettable underwater memories for snorkeling enthusiasts.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment in an Overwater Bungalow
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature couples' spa ritual at a luxury overwater spa where the treatment room features a glass floor revealing the vibrant reef below. Choose from traditional Maldivian coconut oil massages, flower baths, and aromatherapy rituals designed for two. The combination of soothing treatments, ocean sounds, and the visual spectacle of marine life beneath you creates an unparalleled luxury and romance experience tailored for honeymooners.
experiences.location: South Malé Atoll, Olhuveli or Anantara Dhigu Resort

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank rising just inches above the Indian Ocean, where a private table is set for two with fine linens, candles, and a gourmet seafood feast prepared by a resort chef. Feast on freshly grilled lobster, Maldivian tuna curry, and tropical desserts while surrounded by nothing but endless blue water and sky. This exclusive dining experience is the ultimate romantic gesture for couples celebrating a honeymoon.
experiences.location: Ari Atoll, near Mirihi or Lily Beach Resort sandbanks

experiences.name: Night Snorkeling with Bioluminescent Plankton
experiences.description: After dark, slip into the warm lagoon waters to witness one of nature's most magical phenomena — bioluminescent plankton that glow electric blue with every movement. Guided by an expert marine biologist, you and your partner will snorkel through a living light show that illuminates the water around you like a galaxy of stars. This rare, awe-inspiring experience is deeply romantic and unlike anything else available in the world, making it a must-do for honeymooners.
experiences.location: Raa Atoll, Vaadhoo Island (Sea of Stars)

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and prepare for arrival.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, then meet your private resort transfer coordinator. Board a luxury speedboat transfer to your boutique resort in North Malé Atoll near Veligandu or Baros Island (~20–45 min). Upon arrival, enjoy a traditional Maldivian welcome with fresh coconut water and flower garlands. Check in to your overwater villa, unpack, and take a leisurely private villa plunge pool dip while soaking in the Indian Ocean panorama.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — board your exclusively chartered traditional wooden dhoni as the sun dips toward the horizon. Sip premium champagne, enjoy canapés, and watch the sky turn gold and crimson over the atoll. Return to the resort for a romantic beachside dinner under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on board your flight or at the airport lounge before landing.
meals.lunch: Light welcome refreshments and tropical fruit platter served upon check-in at the resort.
meals.dinner: Romantic à la carte dinner at the resort's signature overwater restaurant — freshly caught grilled lobster, saffron risotto, and a curated Maldivian-inspired tasting menu with fine wine pairing.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your speedboat transfer with the resort in advance. Ensure your villa preferences (rose petal turndown, champagne on arrival) are communicated before check-in for a seamless honeymoon welcome.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up to sunrise over the lagoon from your overwater villa deck. Enjoy a private in-villa breakfast delivered by butler service. After breakfast, gear up for a guided house reef snorkeling session directly accessible from your villa or the resort's jetty — explore vibrant coral gardens, spot sea turtles, reef sharks, and schools of tropical fish in the crystal-clear North Malé Atoll waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Spa Treatment in an Overwater Bungalow — indulge in a signature couples' spa ritual where the treatment room floor is made of glass, allowing you to watch marine life drift beneath you as you receive synchronized massages, aromatherapy wraps, and rejuvenating facials. This deeply relaxing session is perfectly timed for the afternoon lull.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the private beach at dusk. Freshen up and head to the resort's sunset cocktail lounge for handcrafted tropical cocktails. Dine at the resort's beach grill restaurant with your feet in the sand — enjoy a seafood barbecue spread featuring Maldivian-spiced tuna, prawns, and reef fish with live acoustic music in the background.

meals.breakfast: Lavish in-villa butler breakfast — fresh tropical fruits, eggs Benedict, freshly baked pastries, freshly squeezed juices, and Maldivian roshi flatbread with coconut sambal.
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach café — grilled fish tacos, fresh ceviche, and a chilled passion fruit mocktail.
meals.dinner: Beachside barbecue dinner at the resort's sand-floor grill — freshly caught seafood, grilled lobster tails, and a decadent chocolate lava cake dessert with fine rosé wine.

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa treatment at least 24 hours in advance to secure the couples' room. Bring reef-safe sunscreen for snorkeling — the resort may provide biodegradable options at the dive center.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided sunrise kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding session across the glassy lagoon — a serene and romantic way to begin the day. Watch the atoll wake up in golden light before returning for a leisurely breakfast. Follow with a visit to the resort's marine biology center for a brief orientation on the local reef ecosystem and responsible snorkeling practices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — be whisked away by private speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank rising just inches above the Indian Ocean. A resort team will have set up a beautifully styled picnic with linen, lanterns, a gourmet hamper, chilled wines, and fresh tropical fruits. Swim, sunbathe, and enjoy total privacy in the middle of the ocean — a quintessential Maldivian honeymoon moment.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in time for sunset. Enjoy a private couples' yoga session on the villa deck or beach, led by the resort's wellness instructor. Dine at the resort's fine-dining restaurant featuring a chef's tasting menu with wine pairings.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant buffet breakfast — an extensive spread of international and Maldivian dishes, fresh juices, tropical fruits, live egg station, and artisan pastries.
meals.lunch: Gourmet sandbank picnic hamper — charcuterie and cheese boards, smoked salmon blinis, lobster rolls, fresh fruit, macarons, and a bottle of chilled Whispering Angel rosé.
meals.dinner: Chef's tasting menu at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — seven courses featuring Maldivian-inspired contemporary cuisine with sommelier-curated wine pairings.

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic must be pre-booked and is weather-dependent. Confirm the booking the evening before. Bring waterproof sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat as the sandbank offers no shade.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent morning with in-villa breakfast and a private plunge pool session. Head to the resort's dive and water sports center to arrange a guided snorkeling excursion to a nearby coral reef pinnacle known for its abundant marine biodiversity — look out for Napoleon wrasse, hawksbill turtles, and vibrant soft corals.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's overwater spa for individual treatments — choose from a deep tissue massage, hot stone therapy, or a traditional Maldivian coconut oil treatment. Spend the remaining afternoon relaxing on your private villa sundeck with a curated cocktail from the butler service and a good book.
day_by_day.evening: Night Snorkeling with Bioluminescent Plankton — after dark, slip into the warm lagoon waters in the company of a guide and witness one of nature's most magical phenomena. The bioluminescent plankton lights up the water in ethereal blue-green flickers with every movement, creating an otherworldly and deeply romantic experience unique to the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: In-villa butler breakfast — avocado toast, smoked salmon, tropical fruit bowl, freshly brewed Maldivian coffee, and a selection of herbal teas.
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant lunch — chilled gazpacho, seared tuna tataki, and a tropical dessert platter with coconut sorbet.
meals.dinner: Casual yet elegant dinner at the resort's lagoon-view restaurant after the bioluminescent snorkeling experience — light Maldivian curry with roshi, grilled fish, and a warm chocolate fondant to finish.

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent plankton experience is best on nights with minimal moonlight. Check the lunar calendar with your resort coordinator when booking. The experience typically lasts 45–60 minutes and is led by a certified marine guide.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise fishing excursion on a traditional Maldivian dhoni — try your hand at line fishing in the traditional Maldivian style alongside an experienced local fisherman. The catch of the morning can be brought back to the resort chef to be prepared as part of your lunch — a truly farm-to-table (or sea-to-table) experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and hand your catch to the chef. Enjoy a leisurely swim in the villa's private plunge pool before heading to the resort's overwater spa for a couples' hammam ritual — a luxurious steam, exfoliation, and hydrating wrap treatment designed to deeply nourish sun-kissed skin.
day_by_day.evening: Private in-villa dining experience — your butler will set up a romantic candlelit table on your overwater villa deck above the lagoon. Enjoy a bespoke multi-course dinner prepared by your personal chef, featuring your morning's catch alongside premium imported ingredients, accompanied by a curated wine selection.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast served early — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, granola, and strong Maldivian coffee.
meals.lunch: Your morning's catch prepared by the resort chef — grilled or pan-seared with Maldivian spices, served with coconut rice, fresh salad, and tropical fruit juice.
meals.dinner: Private overwater villa dinner — five-course bespoke menu including amuse-bouche, fresh oysters, seared foie gras, lobster thermidor, and a decadent dessert platter with champagne.

day_by_day.notes: Coordinate the fishing excursion and private villa dinner with your butler at least two days in advance. Specify any dietary preferences or allergies when arranging the bespoke chef's menu.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full morning of leisure — sleep in, enjoy a slow in-villa breakfast, and spend time floating in your private plunge pool or on the villa's sun loungers. Mid-morning, join the resort's guided house reef snorkeling tour to discover hidden coral formations and marine life just steps from your villa — the house reef in North Malé Atoll is often teeming with turtles and rays.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in a private Maldivian cooking class hosted by the resort's head chef. Learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and freshly made roshi flatbread. This cultural and culinary experience is both romantic and memorable.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's sky bar or overwater lounge, followed by dinner at the resort's main restaurant with a special Maldivian cultural performance — traditional Bodu Beru drumming and dance performed by local artists, offering an authentic glimpse into Maldivian heritage.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — eggs your way, smoked salmon bagels, tropical fruit platter, freshly squeezed juices, and artisan pastries.
meals.lunch: Enjoy the fruits of your cooking class — a shared Maldivian feast of mas huni, garudhiya, roshi, and fresh coconut water.
meals.dinner: Resort main restaurant dinner with cultural performance — a curated Maldivian-inspired menu featuring fresh seafood, coconut-based curries, and a grand dessert buffet.

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class typically lasts 2–3 hours and should be pre-booked. It is a fantastic way to connect with local culture and bring home a culinary souvenir from your honeymoon.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Baa Atoll for the Snorkeling the Manta Ray Biosphere Reserve experience — depart by private speedboat or seaplane (coordinate transfer with the resort) to the UNESCO-recognized Baa Atoll Biosphere Reserve. This is one of the world's most extraordinary snorkeling destinations, home to aggregations of manta rays, whale sharks, and exceptional coral biodiversity. Snorkel with a certified marine biologist guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring the Baa Atoll marine reserve — snorkel additional sites such as Hanifaru Bay (subject to seasonal access) or nearby coral gardens. Enjoy a gourmet picnic lunch served on the boat or at a private beach stop before the return journey to your resort.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon, refreshed and exhilarated. Unwind with a relaxing bath drawn by your butler with essential oils and flower petals. Enjoy a romantic dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant with panoramic ocean views and a special honeymoon dessert arranged by the resort team.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before departure — continental spread with fresh fruits, pastries, yogurt, and strong coffee.
meals.lunch: Gourmet boat picnic — artisan sandwiches, fresh salads, tropical fruits, sparkling water, and chilled juices served aboard or on a private beach.
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant dinner — fresh Maldivian seafood platter, champagne risotto, and a bespoke honeymoon dessert with personalized message from the chef.

day_by_day.notes: The Baa Atoll excursion requires advance planning — confirm with the resort whether a speedboat day trip or seaplane connection is available from North Malé Atoll. Manta ray aggregations at Hanifaru Bay are most common between May and November, so March sightings may vary — the guide will advise on best snorkeling spots for the season.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning entirely to relaxation and wellness. Begin with a private sunrise meditation session on the beach led by the resort's wellness guru. Follow with a rejuvenating dip in the lagoon before a nourishing breakfast. Book a morning slot at the resort's overwater spa for individual wellness treatments — choose from a Balinese massage, reflexology, or an anti-aging facial.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's water sports offerings — try jet skiing, wakeboarding, or a thrilling parasailing experience over the turquoise lagoon for an adrenaline contrast to the morning's tranquility. Alternatively, rent a private catamaran for a gentle afternoon sail around the atoll.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private stargazing experience with the resort — lay on cushioned sun loungers on the beach or villa deck as an astronomy guide uses a high-powered telescope to identify constellations, planets, and galaxies above the unpolluted Maldivian night sky. End the evening with a nightcap of aged whisky or dessert wine on your villa deck.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the resort's health café — açaí bowls, green smoothies, chia pudding, poached eggs, avocado, and herbal teas.
meals.lunch: Poolside or beach club lunch — fresh sushi and sashimi platter, miso soup, edamame, and chilled sake or sparkling water.
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining — a light yet indulgent dinner of pan-seared sea bass, truffle pasta, and a cheese board with port wine, served on the villa deck.

day_by_day.notes: Stargazing experiences are best arranged on nights with minimal cloud cover and a new moon phase. Ask the resort concierge to check the lunar calendar and weather forecast when booking.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a guided dolphin watching cruise — Maldivian waters are famous for spinner dolphins, and early morning is the best time to spot them leaping and spinning alongside the boat. The cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours and is both exhilarating and deeply joyful. Return to the resort for a late breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a private snorkeling safari — your resort's dive center will arrange a private guided boat trip to two or three of the best snorkeling spots in the North Malé Atoll, including coral gardens, reef walls, and potential shark and ray sightings. Enjoy the exclusivity of having a marine guide entirely to yourselves.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — relive the magic of Day 1's sunset cruise, this time with a different route and a curated selection of premium Champagne and gourmet canapés. Watch the sky turn spectacular shades of orange and purple before returning for a final romantic dinner.

meals.breakfast: Late breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — full Maldivian and international buffet with live cooking stations.
meals.lunch: On-boat picnic during the snorkeling safari — fresh sandwiches, tropical fruit skewers, energy bars, and chilled coconut water.
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant — Wagyu beef tenderloin, seared scallops, truffle mashed potato, and a decadent chocolate and raspberry dessert with a glass of vintage Bordeaux.

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed but are very common in the Maldives. The best months are typically December through April, making March an excellent time for this excursion. Bring a camera with a good zoom lens.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a completely unscheduled morning of pure luxury — sleep in as long as you wish, enjoy a lavish in-villa breakfast in bed, and spend time in your private plunge pool or on the villa's overwater deck. This is your day to simply be present in paradise without any agenda.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's boutique spa for a full afternoon of pampering — book the resort's signature half-day spa journey for couples, which typically includes a full-body scrub, wrap, massage, facial, and a private hydrotherapy bath ritual. This is the ultimate indulgence for a honeymoon afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a private Maldivian cultural experience arranged by the resort — a local artisan demonstrates traditional lacquerwork (laajehun) or mat weaving (thundu kunaa), giving you insight into centuries-old Maldivian craftsmanship. Afterward, enjoy a final cocktail at the overwater bar and a relaxed dinner.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast in bed — freshly baked croissants, smoked salmon, scrambled eggs, tropical fruit, freshly squeezed orange juice, and a Maldivian coffee blend.
meals.lunch: Light spa-day lunch at the wellness café — detox salads, cold-pressed juices, quinoa bowls, and herbal infusions.
meals.dinner: Casual elegant dinner at the resort's beach restaurant — grilled Maldivian lobster, coconut prawn curry, steamed jasmine rice, and a fresh mango sorbet dessert.

day_by_day.notes: The half-day spa journey should be booked 48 hours in advance due to high demand. Wear comfortable, loose clothing on your way to the spa. Hydrate well before and after treatments.

day_by_day.morning: Take a day trip to Malé, the vibrant Maldivian capital, accessible by speedboat from North Malé Atoll (~20–30 min). Explore the colorful Friday Mosque (Hukuru Miskiy), the National Museum, and the lively local fish market — a fascinating contrast to the tranquility of your resort. Browse local shops for Maldivian handicrafts, black coral jewelry, and lacquerware souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Malé — visit the vibrant local market for fresh tropical fruits and spices. Enjoy lunch at a local Maldivian café for an authentic taste of everyday island cuisine. Return to the resort by mid-afternoon and unwind with a swim and a relaxing hour on the villa deck.
day_by_day.evening: Night Snorkeling with Bioluminescent Plankton (second experience) — if conditions are favorable, repeat this magical experience for those who want to relive it or experience it differently with a different guide. Alternatively, enjoy a quiet evening with a private movie screening arranged on the beach or villa deck by your butler.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before departure — fresh fruit, pastries, yogurt, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Authentic local lunch in Malé — try short eats (hedhikaa) such as bajiya (fish pastries), gulha (fish dumplings), and fresh tuna curry with roshi at a local café.
meals.dinner: Special honeymoon dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — a bespoke seven-course tasting menu created personally by the executive chef, paired with a curated wine journey from Burgundy, Tuscany, and Marlborough.

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting Malé — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local Islamic culture. The fish market is most vibrant in the early morning when fishing boats return, but the afternoon visit still offers a colorful experience.

day_by_day.morning: Final full-day snorkeling adventure — arrange a private guided snorkeling trip to the best reef sites in the North Malé Atoll, including spots you may not have visited yet. Focus on drift snorkeling along a reef wall for an effortless, exhilarating experience as gentle currents carry you past walls of coral, fish, and marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a final afternoon of pure relaxation. Spend time in the villa's plunge pool, on the sun deck, or floating in the lagoon. Begin a light souvenir shopping session at the resort's boutique — pick up Maldivian-made products, fine jewelry, and keepsakes. Pack non-essential items in preparation for tomorrow's departure.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner — the resort team arranges a special private beach dinner for two, complete with a personalized table setup, candles, lanterns, tropical flower arrangements, and a bespoke menu created in your honor. Toast to your honeymoon with a bottle of vintage Champagne under the Maldivian stars.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant buffet — full international and Maldivian spread, fresh juices, live cooking stations, and artisan pastries.
meals.lunch: Light beach club lunch — fresh ceviche, grilled fish skewers, tropical fruit platter, and sparkling water.
meals.dinner: Private farewell beach dinner — personalized multi-course menu featuring your favorite dishes from the trip, a honeymoon cake, and a bottle of vintage Dom Pérignon Champagne.

day_by_day.notes: Coordinate the farewell beach dinner with your butler at least 48 hours in advance so the team can personalize every detail — flowers, music, lighting, menu preferences, and any special surprises. This is the highlight evening of your honeymoon.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise — wake up early one last time to watch the sun rise over the Indian Ocean from your villa deck. Enjoy a slow, sentimental in-villa breakfast with your butler. Take a final swim in the lagoon or plunge pool. Complete packing and check out of the villa — the resort team will handle all luggage logistics.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, enjoy a final leisure hour at the resort's pool or beach lounge. Board your private speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport in Malé. At the airport, access the premium lounge for refreshments and comfortable seating before your departure flight.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives with hearts full of memories — your honeymoon in paradise concludes. (No dinner scheduled unless departure is late evening, in which case dine at the airport premium lounge or on board your flight.)

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa butler breakfast — a special send-off spread with your favorite items from the trip, freshly squeezed juices, artisan pastries, and Maldivian coffee.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beach café or airport premium lounge — sandwiches, fresh salads, and tropical fruit.
meals.dinner: Airport premium lounge dining or in-flight dining on your departure flight.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your speedboat transfer time with the resort the evening before — allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the boat transfer, airport check-in, immigration, and security. Keep your most treasured keepsakes and documents in your carry-on. The resort can arrange a complimentary late checkout (subject to availability) if your flight departs in the evening.
